full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：密度泛函理论和电子结构计算, 电子—声子耦合与输运，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Why Fe doping kills photoluminescence in CsPbCl₃ but not in CsPbBr₃: Role of midgap Fe 3d states and electron-phonon coupling》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A Density-Matrix Formulation of Vibrational Circular Dichroism Spectra for Møller-Plesset and Configuration Interaction Methods
full_list.title_zh: Møller-Plesset 振动圆二色光谱的密度矩阵公式和构型相互作用方法
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.35392v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We reformulate the overlap of wave-function derivatives that defines the atomic axial tensors (AATs) and velocity-gauge atomic polar tensors (VG-APTs) used to compute vibrational circular dichroism (VCD) rotatory strengths. In place of our earlier determinant-level derivatives, the new approach expresses these tensors as contractions involving molecular-orbital derivative integrals, perturbed and unperturbed one- and two-electron density matrices, and dot products of the perturbed correlated wave-function amplitudes. Following the elegant treatment of the diagonal Born-Oppenheimer correction by Gauss and co-workers, the formulation holds for any real, normalized CI-like wave function. The two-electron density contribution vanishes exactly, because one perturbation is real (nuclear) and the other imaginary (magnetic field or momentum); this removes multiple terms from our earlier AAT and VG-APT expressions for second-order Mø{}ller-Plesset perturbation theory (MP2) and configuration interaction singles and doubles (CISD). We also present a simplified form of the origin-independent length-gauge [LG(OI)] rotatory strength that avoids the singular-value decomposition of the outer product of the length-gauge APT and VG-APT vectors for each mode, and that clarifies how the LG(OI) and velocity-gauge rotatory strengths are related. Applying the density-based AATs and VG-APTs to (P)-hydrogen peroxide, (S)-methyloxirane, and (S)-3-chloro-1-butyne, we find that discrepancies among the gauges arise chiefly from basis-set incompleteness in the VG-APT. The charge-sum rule serves as a useful measure of that incompleteness, independent of the correlation method.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们重新表述了波函数导数的重叠，定义了用于计算振动圆二色性（VCD）旋转强度的原子轴张量（AAT）和速度规原子极张量（VG-APT）。新方法取代了我们早期的行列式级导数，将这些张量表示为涉及分子轨道导数积分、扰动和未扰动的一电子和二电子密度矩阵以及扰动相关波函数振幅的点积的收缩。遵循高斯及其同事对对角玻恩-奥本海默校正的优雅处理，该公式适用于任何真实的、归一化的类 CI 波函数。双电子密度的贡献完全消失，因为一种扰动是真实的（核），另一种是虚构的（磁场或动量）；

full_list.title_en: Altermagnetic Signatures and Topological Textures in Ultrathin Multiferroic BiFeO₃
full_list.title_zh: 超薄多铁性 BiFeO₃ 中的交变磁特征和拓扑结构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.09970v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Magnetoelectric multiferroics promise low-power switching, nonvolatile memory, and signal transduction, yet practical deployment requires ultrathin films where polar and magnetic order often degrade. Uncompensated bound charge drives depolarization in ferroelectrics, while off-stoichiometry, reduced anisotropy, and charge transfer can produce magnetic dead layers. Here, we realize a multiferroic phase of BiFeO₃ with no dead layer, revealing signatures of emergent altermagnetism in the ultrathin limit. First-principles calculations, symmetry analysis, atomic-resolution imaging, and magnetic imaging show that short-circuit electrostatic boundary conditions and epitaxial strain drive a continuous, thickness-induced phase transition accompanied by multiferroic topological textures. At four unit cells, these boundary conditions stabilize a collinear monoclinic phase with d-wave altermagnetic order, supported by magnetic circular dichroism and spin-resolved photoemission measurements. These results establish a pathway to stabilize unconventional multiferroicity at device-relevant thicknesses, reframing scaling limits for oxide electronics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 磁电多铁性材料有望实现低功耗开关、非易失性存储器和信号传导，但实际部署需要超薄膜，而超薄膜的极性和磁序经常会降低。未补偿的束缚电荷会驱动铁电体的去极化，而非化学计量、降低的各向异性和电荷转移会产生磁死层。在这里，我们实现了没有死层的 BiFeO₃ 多铁相，揭示了超薄极限下出现的交变磁性的特征。第一原理计算、对称性分析、原子分辨率成像和磁成像表明，短路静电边界条件和外延应变驱动连续的、厚度诱导的相变，并伴有多铁性拓扑纹理。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 磁电多铁性材料有望实现低功耗开关、非易失性存储器和信号传导，但实际部署需要超薄膜，而超薄膜的极性和磁序经常会降低。未补偿的束缚电荷会驱动铁电体的去极化，而非化学计量、降低的各向异性和电荷转移会产生磁死层。在这里，我们实现了没有死层的 BiFeO₃ 多铁相，揭示了超薄极限下出现的交变磁性的特征。第一原理计算、对称性分析、原子分辨率成像和磁成像表明，短路静电边界条件和外延应变驱动连续的、厚度诱导的相变，并伴有多铁性拓扑纹理。在四个晶胞中，这些边界条件稳定了具有 d 波交变磁序的共线单斜相，并得到磁圆二色性和自旋分辨光电发射测量的支持。这些结果建立了一条在器件相关厚度下稳定非常规多铁性的途径，重新定义了氧化物电子器件的缩放限制。

full_list.title_en: Annealing-atmosphere control of paramagnetic defects in ZnO microparticles
full_list.title_zh: ZnO 微粒中顺磁性缺陷的退火气氛控制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.33870v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we used temperature-dependent electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy to reveal the effect of high-temperature annealing in N2 and air on paramagnetic and electronic properties of ZnO microparticles. EPR spectral simulations have shown that N2 annealing produces Zni, VO+, and shallow-donor centers, whereas Zni, VO+, and Hi-related centers are observed after annealing the ZnO microparticles in an air atmosphere. The resolved paramagnetic centers exhibit distinctly different behavior over 5-297 K. The shallow-donor and Hi signals are rapidly quenched below approximately 50 K, while the Zni contribution shows a nonmonotonic temperature dependence. In contrast, the VO+ signal persists up to room temperature and increases with temperature, consistent with charge redistribution among donor-related defects involving deep oxygen-vacancy states. The cavity Q-factor generally decreases with increasing temperature for both annealed samples, indicating atmosphere-dependent changes in the microwave losses. These results show that the annealing atmosphere controls the paramagnetic defect population, the temperature dependence of donor-related centers, and the associated electronic response of ZnO microparticles.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们使用温度依赖性电子顺磁共振（EPR）光谱来揭示氮气和空气中的高温退火对ZnO微粒的顺磁和电子性质的影响。 EPR光谱模拟表明，N2退火产生Zn、VO+和浅施主中心，而ZnO微粒在空气气氛中退火后观察到Zn、VO+和Hi相关中心。解析的顺磁中心在 5-297 K 范围内表现出明显不同的行为。浅施主和 Hi 信号在大约 50 K 以下迅速淬灭，而 Zni 贡献显示出非单调温度依赖性。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《ZnO 微粒中顺磁性缺陷的退火气氛控制》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Anomalous mass renormalization in two-dimensional electron systems on ultra-wide bandgap semiconductor β-Ga₂O₃
full_list.title_zh: 超宽带隙半导体 β-Ga2O₃ 二维电子系统反常质量重正化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2507.16137v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Two-dimensional electron systems (2DESs) at wide-bandgap semiconductor surfaces and interfaces are fertile ground for emergent quantum phenomena. Here, we use micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) to resolve the momentum-space electronic structure of a surface 2DES in β-Ga₂O₃, an ultra-wide bandgap semiconductor with a band gap of 4.7 eV. In situ electron doping of cleaved, high-purity β-Ga₂O₃ single crystals produces an essentially circular Fermi surface. With the self-consistent Poisson-Schrödinger model, the 2D electrons are estimated to be confined within approximately 1.2 nm beneath the surface, with an internal electric field of approximately 18 MV cm⁻¹. Our analysis based on ARPES measurements reveals nearly a twofold increase in the electron mass at high sheet carrier densities. This trend deviates from the conventional behavior reported for wide-bandgap semiconductors and indicates mass renormalization beyond the conventional screening-based picture. Our results provide quantitative momentum-space benchmarks for the Fermi-surface geometry and density-dependent quasiparticle dispersion of the β-Ga₂O₃ 2DES, opening a route to studying density-tunable interfacial quantum states in the UWBG regime.
full_list.abstract_zh: 宽带隙半导体表面和界面上的二维电子系统（2DES）是涌现量子现象的沃土。在这里，我们使用微聚焦角分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 来解析 β-Ga2O₃（一种带隙为 4.7 eV 的超宽带隙半导体）中表面 2DES 的动量空间电子结构。对解理的高纯度 β-Ga2O3 单晶进行原位电子掺杂可产生基本上圆形的费米面。利用自洽泊松-薛定谔模型，估计二维电子被限制在表面下方约 1.2 nm 的范围内，内部电场约为 18 MV cm-1。

full_list.title_en: Boundary-condition independence of infinite-chain ground states in the S=1 J-D antiferromagnetic chain
full_list.title_zh: S=1 J-D 反铁磁链中无限链基态的边界条件独立性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34330v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Extending the analytic machinery and using the numerical inputs from OpenAI's proofs of the Haldane gap, we study infinite-chain ground states of the S=1 J-D antiferromagnetic model H=sumⱼ{boldsymbol Sⱼ·boldsymbol Sⱼ₊₁+D(Sⱼmathrm z)²} for sufficiently small |D|. We consider two finite-volume settings: periodic chains with an even number of sites, and open chains with an odd number of sites and the same positive magnetic field in the mathrm z direction at both endpoints. We prove that the ground states in each setting have an infinite-chain limit along the full sequence, without passing to a subsequence, and that the two limiting states coincide. Convergence is uniform in D on a fixed neighborhood of zero. The common limit is a symmetric locally-unique gapped ground state, and its local expectation values depend continuously on D. These conclusions concern the two specified constructions, not uniqueness among all infinite-chain ground states. They provide the input for the study of a topological phase transition in a forthcoming revision of our companion paper. The author formulated the problem and proposed the basic strategy. ChatGPT Astra made substantial contributions to the inductive estimates and to completing the proof.
full_list.abstract_zh: 扩展分析机制并使用 OpenAI 霍尔丹能隙证明中的数值输入，我们研究了 S=1 J-D 反铁磁模型 H=sumⱼ{boldsymbol Sⱼ·boldsymbol Sⱼ₊₁+D(Sⱼmathrm z)²} 的无限链基态，其中 |D| 足够小。我们考虑两种有限体积设置：具有偶数个位点的周期链，以及具有奇数个位点且两个端点在 mathrm z 方向上具有相同正磁场的开链。我们证明，每个设置中的基态在整个序列上都有一个无限链限制，而无需传递到子序列，并且两个极限状态是一致的。

full_list.title_en: Co layer Thickness Driven Structural Evolution and Magnetic Behaviour of Co/Ir/Co Trilayers
full_list.title_zh: Co层厚度驱动的Co/Ir/Co三层结构演化和磁性行为
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.33595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferromagnetic heavy-metal (FM/HM) trilayer heterostructures provide a versatile platform for investigating the interplay between structural and magnetic properties. In this study, we investigate the effect of Co-layer thickness on the structural and magnetic properties of sputter-deposited Co(tCₒ)/Ir(5,nm)/Co(tCₒ) varying from 2 to 10 nm. Structural characterization using grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) reveals a nanocrystalline structure, with the crystallite size increasing with Co-layer thickness. Furthermore, X-ray reflectivity (XRR) reveals a thickness-dependent variation in interface morphology, with the interface roughness ratio reaching a maximum at tCₒ = 4 nm. Temperature-dependent zero-field-cooled and field-cooled (ZFC-FC) magnetization measurements reveal thickness-dependent characteristic temperatures and multiple relaxation regimes in selected samples, indicating complex thermally activated magnetic behaviour. In contrast, field-dependent hysteresis measurements reveal that the saturation magnetization increases with Co-layer thickness, whereas the coercivity exhibits a pronounced non-monotonic variation, with enhanced values at intermediate thicknesses. Moreover, low-temperature hysteresis loops display thickness-dependent exchange-bias-like shifts, particularly for tCₒ = 2-4 nm. These findings highlight the strong influence of Co-layer thickness on the structural and magnetic properties of Co/Ir/Co trilayers.
full_list.abstract_zh: 铁磁重金属 (FM/HM) 三层异质结构为研究结构和磁性之间的相互作用提供了一个多功能平台。在本研究中，我们研究了 Co 层厚度对溅射沉积 Co(tCₒ)/Ir(5,nm)/Co(tCₒ) 结构和磁性能的影响，厚度范围为 2 至 10 nm。使用掠入射 X 射线衍射 (GIXRD) 和高分辨率透射电子显微镜 (HRTEM) 进行的结构表征揭示了纳米晶体结构，微晶尺寸随着 Co 层厚度的增加而增加。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 铁磁重金属 (FM/HM) 三层异质结构为研究结构和磁性之间的相互作用提供了一个多功能平台。在本研究中，我们研究了 Co 层厚度对溅射沉积 Co(tCₒ)/Ir(5,nm)/Co(tCₒ) 结构和磁性能的影响，厚度范围为 2 至 10 nm。使用掠入射 X 射线衍射 (GIXRD) 和高分辨率透射电子显微镜 (HRTEM) 进行的结构表征揭示了纳米晶体结构，微晶尺寸随着 Co 层厚度的增加而增加。此外，X 射线反射率 (XRR) 揭示了界面形态随厚度的变化，界面粗糙度比在 tCₒ = 4 nm 时达到最大值。温度相关的零场冷却和场冷却 (ZFC-FC) 磁化测量揭示了所选样品中厚度相关的特征温度和多个弛豫状态，表明复杂的热激活磁行为。相反，场相关磁滞测量表明，饱和磁化强度随着Co层厚度的增加而增加，而矫顽力表现出明显的非单调变化，在中间厚度处值增强。此外，低温磁滞回线显示出与厚度相关的交换偏置样变化，特别是在 tCₒ = 2-4 nm 时。这些发现强调了Co层厚度对Co/Ir/Co三层结构和磁性能的强烈影响。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Co层厚度驱动的Co/Ir/Co三层结构演化和磁性行为》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Coexistence of Ferromagnetic and Overscreened Kondo Effects in a Single Molecule
full_list.title_zh: 单分子中铁磁效应和超屏蔽近藤效应的共存
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2604.07174v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The quest for quantum ground states beyond the Fermi-liquid paradigm remains a central challenge in many-body physics. The ferromagnetic Kondo effect is an intriguing variant of the Kondo effect in which an asymptotically free spin gives rise to singular Fermi-liquid behavior. Despite its theoretical importance, this regime has eluded experimental observation owing to subtle spectroscopic signatures, small energy scales, and symmetry constraints in nanostructures. Here, we demonstrate the coexistence of ferromagnetic and overscreened Kondo effects within a molecular spin system---a triangulene dimer comprising spin-1 and spin-1/2 units adsorbed on a metal surface. Low-temperature scanning tunneling spectroscopy reveals signatures of singular Fermi-liquid behavior, supported by many-body calculations. The molecular design provides control over spin configuration and coupling asymmetry, allowing distinct regimes within the same platform. Our results establish a strategy for realizing non-Fermi-liquid physics at the atomic scale and demonstrate that ferromagnetic Kondo behavior can be deliberately engineered in molecular systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 寻求超越费米液体范式的量子基态仍然是多体物理学的核心挑战。铁磁近藤效应是近藤效应的一个有趣的变体，其中渐近自由自旋产生奇异的费米液体行为。尽管其理论上很重要，但由于纳米结构中微妙的光谱特征、较小的能量尺度和对称性限制，该体系未能通过实验观察。在这里，我们证明了分子自旋系统中铁磁效应和过筛近藤效应的共存——由吸附在金属表面上的 spin-1 和 spin-1/2 单元组成的三角烯二聚体。低温扫描隧道光谱揭示了奇异费米液体行为的特征，并得到多体计算的支持。

full_list.title_en: Collinear and Coplanar Altermagnetism in a Penrose Quasicrystal
full_list.title_zh: 彭罗斯准晶体中的共线和共面交变磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.35855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We generalize the previous group-theory based classification of collinear magnetism in the quasicrystal (QC) to general magnetic states. Taking the Penrose lattice as an example, we find that all magnetic states belonging to 2D irreducible representations (IRRPs) of the D₅ point group, including collinear states and coplanar ones, correspond to altermagnetism (AM). Unlike conventional collinear AM wherein zero magnetism is protected by, e.g. rotation or mirror reflection, which globally flip the spin in the magnetic pattern, the zero magnetism in these 2D-IRRP states is instead protected by a special group-theory-orthogonality theorem that basis functions belonging to different IRRPs are always mutually orthogonal. Taking the single-orbital Penrose-Hubbard as an example, our linear-response theory based calculations show that the largest portion of the parameter space is occupied by these 2D-IRRP states, and our further Ginzburg-Landau theory based analysis reveals that the polarization directions of the two basis magnetic states in the 2D IRRPs can be either parallel or perpendicular, leading to collinear or coplanar magnetic states. The special group-theory-orthogonality compensation mechanism and the absence of the PT symmetry finally leads to AM states, which are to be verified by the spin split in the spin-dependent angle-resolved-photoemission-spectrum and the spin conductance. These intriguing collinear and coplanar AM can also emerge in other QCs.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们将先前基于群论的准晶体（QC）共线磁性分类推广到一般磁态。以彭罗斯晶格为例，我们发现所有属于D₅点群的二维不可约表示（IRRP）的磁态，包括共线态和共面态，都对应于交变磁性（AM）。与传统的共线 AM 不同，其中零磁性受到保护，例如旋转或镜面反射会全局翻转磁性图案中的自旋，这些 2D-IRRP 状态中的零磁性反而受到特殊群论正交定理的保护，该定理属于不同 IRRP 的基函数始终相互正交。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们将先前基于群论的准晶体（QC）共线磁性分类推广到一般磁态。以彭罗斯晶格为例，我们发现所有属于D₅点群的二维不可约表示（IRRP）的磁态，包括共线态和共面态，都对应于交变磁性（AM）。与传统的共线 AM 不同，其中零磁性受到保护，例如旋转或镜面反射会全局翻转磁性图案中的自旋，这些 2D-IRRP 状态中的零磁性反而受到特殊群论正交定理的保护，该定理属于不同 IRRP 的基函数始终相互正交。以单轨道彭罗斯-哈伯德为例，我们基于线性响应理论的计算表明，参数空间的最大部分被这些2D-IRRP态占据，并且我们进一步基于Ginzburg-Landau理论的分析表明，2D IRRP中两个基本磁态的极化方向可以是平行或垂直的，从而导致共线或共面磁态。特殊的群论正交性补偿机制和PT对称性的缺失最终导致AM态，这将通过自旋相关角分辨光电子能谱中的自旋分裂和自旋电导来验证。这些有趣的共线和共面 AM 也可以出现在其他 QC 中。

full_list.title_en: Control of the Electronic and Atomic Structure of the Altermagnetic α-MnTe Surface via Substrate-Induced Surfactants
full_list.title_zh: 通过基质诱导表面活性剂控制交变磁性 α-MnTe 表面的电子和原子结构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.35236v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets are a novel class of materials with unique momentum dependent spin-polarization of the electronic band structure, which opens up new avenues for spintronic devices. Altermagnetic α-MnTe is particularly interesting for such applications due to its giant spin splitting and the persistence of altermagnetic order up to room temperature. Growth of thin films is, however, challenging and governed by interactions with the substrate. As a result, the surface of α-MnTe thin films exhibits very different atomic structures in dependence of the substrate material. Whereas on SrF2(111) an atomically clean, perfectly (2x2) reconstructed surface forms, on InP(111)A the MnTe surface is always InTe terminated due to super-segregation of In from the substrate to the surface. Most strikingly, the InTe surfactant layer displays a quasi-periodic dislocation network to accommodate the InTe/MnTe lattice mismatch. This leads to the emergence of distinct surface states in dependence of surface termination that strongly affect the electronic band structure at the surface as shown by angle resolved photoemission and tunneling spectroscopy. Thus, control and characterization of the atomic structure of the surface is fundamentally important for understanding the properties of altermagnets and provides room for engineering and tailoring of spin-polarized states in actual devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 交替磁体是一类新型材料，具有独特的电子能带结构的动量相关自旋极化，这为自旋电子器件开辟了新途径。交变磁 α-MnTe 由于其巨大的自旋分裂和交变磁序在室温下的持久性而在此类应用中特别有趣。然而，薄膜的生长具有挑战性，并且受到与基底的相互作用的控制。因此，α-MnTe 薄膜的表面根据基底材料表现出非常不同的原子结构。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 交替磁体是一类新型材料，具有独特的电子能带结构的动量相关自旋极化，这为自旋电子器件开辟了新途径。交变磁 α-MnTe 由于其巨大的自旋分裂和交变磁序在室温下的持久性而在此类应用中特别有趣。然而，薄膜的生长具有挑战性，并且受到与基底的相互作用的控制。因此，α-MnTe 薄膜的表面根据基底材料表现出非常不同的原子结构。在 SrF2(111) 上，形成原子级清洁、完美 (2x2) 重构的表面，而在 InP(111)A 上，由于 In 从衬底到表面的超偏析，MnTe 表面始终为 InTe 终止。最引人注目的是，InTe 表面活性剂层显示出准周期位错网络，以适应 InTe/MnTe 晶格失配。这导致依赖于表面终止的不同表面态的出现，强烈影响表面的电子能带结构，如角分辨光电子发射和隧道光谱所示。因此，表面原子结构的控制和表征对于理解交流磁体的特性至关重要，并为实际器件中自旋极化态的工程和定制提供了空间。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过基质诱导表面活性剂控制交变磁性 α-MnTe 表面的电子和原子结构》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Controllable charge-spin conversion in sliding multiferroic metal Fe3GaTe2
full_list.title_zh: 滑动多铁金属 Fe3GaTe2 中的可控电荷自旋转换
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34295v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling charge--spin conversion within a single magnetic material is important for compact spintronic devices. Using first-principles calculations, symmetry analysis, and Wannier-based linear response, we study the Edelstein and spin Hall responses of sliding-ferroelectric bilayer ceFe3GaTe2. Two degenerate ground states with opposite interlayer sliding vectors and out-of-plane dipole moments are separated by a calculated switching barrier of about 16.3~meV per unit cell. Magnetization orientation determines the allowed current-induced spin components, while ferroelectric switching induces component-selective sign reversals governed by M_zmathcal T for in-plane magnetization and by M_z for out-of-plane magnetization. The Edelstein response is strongly energy dependent, with spin accumulation approaching 2~hbar for mathbf mparallel+y under a reference field of 1~V/Å. Momentum-resolved analysis links the TR-even and TR-odd Edelstein responses to Γ-centered constant-energy contours and localized interband features, respectively. Spin-conductivity contributions show the opposite momentum-space character, with broad sign-competing spin Berry curvature for TR-even and narrow Fermi-surface contours for TR-odd. The transverse spin Hall conductivity reaches sim10³,(hbar/e)(S/cm) and depends strongly on ferroelectric state and magnetization direction. Magnetization rotations in the xy and xz planes reveal symmetry-allowed higher angular harmonics in both spin accumulation and spin-current responses. These results establish sliding-ferroelectric bilayer ceFe3GaTe2 as a tunable platform for reconfigurable spin accumulation and spin-current generation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 控制单一磁性材料内的电荷-自旋转换对于紧凑型自旋电子器件非常重要。利用第一性原理计算、对称性分析和基于 Wannier 的线性响应，我们研究了滑动铁电双层 ceFe3GaTe2 的 Edelstein 和自旋霍尔响应。具有相反层间滑动矢量和面外偶极矩的两个简并基态被计算出的每晶胞约 16.3~meV 的转换势垒分开。磁化方向决定了允许的电流感应自旋分量，而铁电切换会引起分量选择性符号反转，其由面内磁化的 M_zmathcal T 和面外磁化的 M_z 控制。

full_list.title_en: Direct observation of a spin-polarized surface Dirac gap in the antiferromagnetic topological insulator NdBi
full_list.title_zh: 反铁磁拓扑绝缘体 NdBi 中自旋极化表面狄拉克间隙的直接观察
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.35353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A gapped Dirac cone in antiferromagnetic topological insulators (AFM-TIs) is essential for realizing the quantized anomalous Hall effect, yet its intrinsic magnitude remains controversial. In the prototypical AFM-TI MnBi2Te4, however, the observed Dirac gap is significantly smaller than theoretical predictions or nearly absent, highlighting a long-standing discrepancy. Here we demonstrate that NdBi hosts a spin-polarized topological surface Dirac cone with a sizable gap of 17 meV at the Dirac point, in excellent agreement with density functional theory predictions (12 meV). This direct observation is enabled by high-resolution 7 eV laser-based spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, which unambiguously disentangles the spin-polarized surface Dirac cone from bulk-derived states. Furthermore, through temperature dependence and controlled surface contamination, we establish a direct linkage between surface magnetism and the Dirac gap, demonstrating that the gap opens only in the presence of surface magnetic order. These results provide definitive spectroscopic evidence for an intrinsic Dirac gap in AFM-TIs and establish NdBi as a model platform to resolve the long-standing discrepancy between experiment and theory in AFM-TIs.
full_list.abstract_zh: 反铁磁拓扑绝缘体（AFM-TI）中的带隙狄拉克锥对于实现量子化反常霍尔效应至关重要，但其内在大小仍然存在争议。然而，在典型的 AFM-TI MnBi2Te4 中，观察到的狄拉克能隙明显小于理论预测或几乎不存在，凸显了长期存在的差异。在这里，我们证明 NdBi 具有自旋极化拓扑表面狄拉克锥，在狄拉克点处具有 17 meV 的相当大的间隙，与密度泛函理论预测 (12 meV) 非常吻合。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁拓扑绝缘体（AFM-TI）中的带隙狄拉克锥对于实现量子化反常霍尔效应至关重要，但其内在大小仍然存在争议。然而，在典型的 AFM-TI MnBi2Te4 中，观察到的狄拉克能隙明显小于理论预测或几乎不存在，凸显了长期存在的差异。在这里，我们证明 NdBi 具有自旋极化拓扑表面狄拉克锥，在狄拉克点处具有 17 meV 的相当大的间隙，与密度泛函理论预测 (12 meV) 非常吻合。这种直接观察是通过基于高分辨率 7 eV 激光的自旋和角度分辨光电子能谱实现的，该光谱明确地将自旋偏振表面狄拉克锥与体衍生态分开。此外，通过温度依赖性和受控表面污染，我们在表面磁性和狄拉克间隙之间建立了直接联系，证明间隙仅在表面磁序存在时打开。这些结果为 AFM-TI 中固有的狄拉克能隙提供了明确的光谱证据，并将 NdBi 建立为模型平台，以解决 AFM-TI 中实验与理论之间长期存在的差异。

full_list.title_en: Electronic Responses in Solid Oxygen with Coexisting Structural and Magnetic Orders
full_list.title_zh: 结构序和磁序共存的固体氧中的电子响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34794v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solid oxygen provides a unique platform for studying the interplay between structural and magnetic degrees of freedom, as each O₂ molecule possesses an S=1 spin and weak intermolecular van der Waals interactions allow substantial structural flexibility. In addition, because of its small intermolecular hopping integrals, this system is known to be a strongly correlated electron system with a multiorbital nature. In this study, we examine electronic states and magnetic and dielectric responses using a multiorbital Hubbard model with Peierls-type electron-lattice coupling. This model provides a minimal description of the interplay between structural and magnetic degrees of freedom in solid oxygen. We apply the Hartree-Fock approximation to obtain the ground-state phase diagram. Antiferromagnetic order appears when the onsite Coulomb interaction is strong, whereas three nonmagnetic bond-ordered states emerge when it is weak. At intermediate interaction strengths, antiferromagnetic order coexists with each of the three bond orders. These three coexistence phases all break time-reversal symmetry; one preserves spatial inversion symmetry, whereas the other two also break it. The two inversion-breaking phases exhibit linear magnetoelectric responses, whereas the inversion-symmetric phase exhibits altermagnetic spin splitting and a piezomagnetic response. These responses may provide experimental signatures of coexisting magnetic and structural orders in high-pressure solid oxygen suggested by recent experiments.
full_list.abstract_zh: 固体氧为研究结构自由度和磁性自由度之间的相互作用提供了一个独特的平台，因为每个 O2 分子都具有 S=1 自旋，并且弱的分子间范德华相互作用允许很大的结构灵活性。此外，由于其较小的分子间跳跃积分，该系统被认为是具有多轨道性质的强相关电子系统。在这项研究中，我们使用具有 Peierls 型电子晶格耦合的多轨道哈伯德模型来检查电子态以及磁和介电响应。该模型提供了对固体氧中结构自由度和磁性自由度之间相互作用的最小描述。我们应用 Hartree-Fock 近似来获得基态相图。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Equivalent Pseudo-angular Momentum Governs Selective Magnon-Phonon Hybridization
full_list.title_zh: 等效赝角动量控制选择性磁振子-声子杂交
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34857v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnon-phonon hybridization provides a powerful route to couple spin and lattice excitations, yet the symmetry principle governing mode selectivity remains unclear. Here, we show that crystalline pseudoangular momentum provides a general criterion for selective magnon-phonon hybridization in noncollinear multisublattice magnetic systems. The rotation eigenvalue associated with pseudoangular momentum encodes polarization transformations, sublattice permutations, and Bloch phases, requiring magnetoelastic coupling between modes belonging to the same rotation sector. We illustrate this principle in a stacked kagome model with noncollinear spin order. An out-of-plane magnetic field tunes one magnon sector into resonance with a degenerate phonon doublet, yet only the pseudoangular-momentum-matched phonon develops a pronounced avoided crossing while the other remains nearly unmixed. Field reversal switches the selected rotation sector and reverses the rotational polarization of the hybridized phonon component without changing the hybrid-mode energies. Our results reveal pseudoangular-momentum matching as a general framework for understanding and controlling mode-selective spin-lattice hybridization.
full_list.abstract_zh: 磁振子-声子杂化提供了耦合自旋和晶格激发的强大途径，但控制模式选择性的对称原理仍不清楚。在这里，我们证明晶体赝角动量为非共线多亚晶格磁系统中的选择性磁振子-声子杂化提供了一般标准。与赝角动量相关的旋转特征值编码极化变换、亚晶格排列和布洛赫相位，需要属于同一旋转扇区的模式之间的磁弹性耦合。我们在具有非共线自旋顺序的堆叠戈薇模型中说明了这一原理。面外磁场将一个磁振子扇区调谐到与简并声子双峰共振，但只有赝角动量匹配的声子产生明显的避免交叉，而另一个磁振子扇区几乎保持未混合。

full_list.title_en: Flexural Altermagnetism
full_list.title_zh: 弯曲交变磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.35238v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We establish flexural deformation as a versatile route for engineering altermagnetism in two-dimensional collinear antiferromagnets. By tailoring the flexure, we selectively break different symmetries to realize altermagnetic states with distinct wave symmetries and reverse their spin splitting. A tight-binding model and first-principles calculations for monolayer MnPS3 demonstrate d- and i-wave states and a switchable transverse spin current in the d-wave state.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们将弯曲变形作为二维共线反铁磁体中工程交变磁性的通用途径。通过定制弯曲，我们有选择地打破不同的对称性，以实现具有不同波对称性的交磁态并逆转它们的自旋分裂。单层 MnPS3 的紧束缚模型和第一原理计算证明了 d 波和 i 波状态以及 d 波状态下的可切换横向自旋电流。

full_list.title_en: High-Q, high-power spin Hall nano-oscillators with thick NiFe layers enabled by SiC substrates
full_list.title_zh: 高 Q、高功率自旋霍尔纳米振荡器，具有由 SiC 衬底实现的厚 NiFe 层
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.35245v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin Hall nano-oscillators (SHNOs) are nanoscale microwave sources with potential applications in local spin excitation, neuromorphic computing, and oscillator-based Ising machines. Further improvements in output power and coherence are essential for these applications, and increasing the thickness of the ferromagnetic layer offers a promising route toward this goal. However, this comes at the cost of higher drive currents, which increase Joule heating and can degrade device performance. Here, we show that this bottleneck can be overcome by SiC substrates. By comparing otherwise identical W/NiFe nanoconstriction SHNOs on Al2O3, Si, and SiC, we find that the high thermal conductivity of SiC enables stable auto-oscillations in NiFe layers as thick as 10 nm, while the optimum performance occurs at 7 nm. The best SiC device reaches an average output power of 13.1 pW and a mean quality factor of Q = 23,000, representing the highest reported simultaneous output power and coherence for a single free-running SHNO. These results establish SiC and thermal substrate engineering as a route to thick-ferromagnet spintronic oscillators for coherent microwave generation in nanoscale devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自旋霍尔纳米振荡器 (SHNO) 是纳米级微波源，在局部自旋激发、神经形态计算和基于振荡器的伊辛机中具有潜在应用。输出功率和相干性的进一步改进对于这些应用至关重要，而增加铁磁层的厚度为实现这一目标提供了一条有希望的途径。然而，这是以更高的驱动电流为代价的，这会增加焦耳热并降低器件性能。在这里，我们证明了碳化硅衬底可以克服这个瓶颈。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 自旋霍尔纳米振荡器 (SHNO) 是纳米级微波源，在局部自旋激发、神经形态计算和基于振荡器的伊辛机中具有潜在应用。输出功率和相干性的进一步改进对于这些应用至关重要，而增加铁磁层的厚度为实现这一目标提供了一条有希望的途径。然而，这是以更高的驱动电流为代价的，这会增加焦耳热并降低器件性能。在这里，我们证明了碳化硅衬底可以克服这个瓶颈。通过比较 Al2O3、Si 和 SiC 上其他相同的 W/NiFe 纳米收缩 SHNO，我们发现 SiC 的高导热率能够在厚至 10 nm 的 NiFe 层中实现稳定的自振荡，而最佳性能出现在 7 nm 处。最好的 SiC 器件达到 13.1 pW 的平均输出功率和 Q = 23,000 的平均品质因数，代表单个自由运行的 SHNO 的最高同步输出功率和相干性。这些结果确立了碳化硅和热衬底工程作为厚铁磁体自旋电子振荡器在纳米级器件中产生相干微波的途径。
full_list.summary: 自旋霍尔纳米振荡器 (SHNO) 是纳米级微波源，在局部自旋激发、神经形态计算和基于振荡器的伊辛机中具有潜在应用。输出功率和相干性的进一步改进对于这些应用至关重要，而增加铁磁层的厚度为实现这一目标提供了一条有希望的途径。然而，这是以更高的驱动电流为代价的，这会增加焦耳热并降低器件性能。在这里，我们证明了碳化硅衬底可以克服这个瓶颈。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《高 Q、高功率自旋霍尔纳米振荡器，具有由 SiC 衬底实现的厚 NiFe 层》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Magnetoelectric Exchange Spring for Spin-Wave Logic with Ultralow Energy Consumption
full_list.title_zh: 用于超低能耗自旋波逻辑的磁电交换弹簧
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34693v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin waves (magnons) are intrinsically free of Joule heating during their propagation in magnets. Exploring, understanding, and manipulating such quasiparticles not only helps reveal the exotic magnonic phenomena in condensed matter physics but also underpins the development of information devices with low energy consumption. However, achieving low-power and scalable control of spin-wave propagation remains a critical challenge. Herein, a magnetoelectric exchange spring has been artificially designed and constructed across an interface between ferroelectric BaTiO3 and ferromagnetic (La,Sr)MnO3 with low magnetic damping, in which polarization-modulated orbital reconstruction tailors local magnetic anisotropy and enables reversible control of spin-wave propagation. By successfully deviating from the Janovec-Kay-Dunn law, reversal polarization of engineered BaTiO3 (Ps~1.2 uC cm⁻², Vc~0.4 V) is sufficient to switch the coherent magnon transport in the (La,Sr)MnO3, indicating the magnetoelectric heterointerface may serve as a promising candidate for atto-joule control of spin-wave propagation (normalized to a 10*10 nm² device). Furthermore, taking advantage of amplitude, phase, and frequency to encode spin waves, all 16 compact Boolean logics with ultralow energy consumption have been designed. The artificial magnetoelectric exchange spring can be broadly applicable to various material choices, offering a versatile platform for developing energy-efficient and integrated magnonic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自旋波（磁振子）在磁体中传播期间本质上不受焦耳热影响。探索、理解和操纵这些准粒子不仅有助于揭示凝聚态物理中奇异的磁波现象，而且还支持低能耗信息设备的发展。然而，实现自旋波传播的低功耗和可扩展控制仍然是一个严峻的挑战。本文中，在铁电 BaTiO3 和铁磁 (La,Sr)MnO3 之间的界面上人工设计和构建了具有低磁阻尼的磁电交换弹簧，其中偏振调制轨道重构调整了局部磁各向异性，并实现了自旋波传播的可逆控制。

full_list.title_en: Orbital Hall response of spin-1 fermions with a curved central band
full_list.title_zh: 具有弯曲中心带的自旋-1费米子的轨道霍尔响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.33211v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the orbital Hall effect in a three-band system described by a low-energy Hamiltonian containing both linear and quadratic momentum-dependent contributions. The linear term lifts the degeneracy between the dispersive bands, providing a minimal setting to study orbital transport in a multiband system with a curved central band. Within a quantum kinetic approach, we derive the intrinsic orbital Hall response and analyze its microscopic origin in terms of interband coherence induced by an external electric field. We show that the orbital Hall conductivity arises from the interplay between the momentum-dependent orbital character of the eigenstates and transitions between different bands. The spin-1 structure provides a particularly transparent platform in which the contributions associated with different interband channels can be identified separately. We further show that the differential orbital Hall response provides a direct probe of the low-energy structure, exhibiting distinct scaling singularities associated with the linear and quadratic bands, respectively, while remaining independent of the ultraviolet cutoff. Our results establish a connection between the multiband quantum geometry of spin-1 fermions and their transverse orbital response, and provide a simple framework for investigating orbital transport beyond two-band models.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了由低能量哈密顿量描述的三波段系统中的轨道霍尔效应，该低能量哈密顿量同时包含线性和二次动量相关的贡献。线性项提升了色散带之间的退化，为研究具有弯曲中心带的多频带系统中的轨道传输提供了最小的设置。在量子动力学方法中，我们推导出内在轨道霍尔响应，并根据外部电场引起的带间相干性分析其微观起源。我们表明，轨道霍尔电导率源于本征态的动量依赖轨道特性与不同波段之间的跃迁之间的相互作用。自旋-1结构提供了一个特别透明的平台，其中可以单独识别与不同带间信道相关联的贡献。

full_list.title_en: Perpendicular Anisotropy and g-Factor of Sputtered Ni Films on Si(111) Studied by Angle-Dependent Ferromagnetic Resonance
full_list.title_zh: 通过角度相关铁磁共振研究 Si(111) 上溅射 Ni 薄膜的垂直各向异性和 g 因子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.33637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ni films with thicknesses of 312 and 1011,Å{} were grown on Si(111) by dc magnetron sputtering at room temperature and studied by atomic force microscopy, grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction, X-ray reflectivity, magnetometry and angle-dependent ferromagnetic resonance. Both films are polycrystalline fcc Ni with smooth surfaces, a bulk-like (111) lattice spacing and a saturation magnetization of approx480,emu,cm⁻³, and both are magnetized in plane. The angular dependence of the resonance field, from the film plane to the film normal, is described by a uniaxial anisotropy model with first- and second-order terms. From this model, g = 2.160±0.005 and 2.101±0.014 and effective perpendicular anisotropies of (6.0±0.4)×10⁵ and (4.5±0.6)×10⁵,erg,cm⁻³ were obtained for the thinner and thicker film, respectively. The conventional analysis of only the in-plane and perpendicular resonances gives g-factors that are lower by 0.02--0.04. The perpendicular linewidths give upper limits for the Gilbert damping of α le 0.030 and le 0.038.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在室温下通过直流磁控溅射在 Si(111) 上生长厚度为 312 和 1011,Å{} 的 Ni 薄膜，并通过原子力显微镜、掠入射 X 射线衍射、X 射线反射率、磁力测量和角度相关铁磁共振进行研究。两种薄膜均为多晶面心立方镍，具有光滑的表面、块状（111）晶格间距和约480,emu,cm³的饱和磁化强度，并且两者均在平面内磁化。从薄膜平面到薄膜法线的共振场的角度依赖性由具有一阶和二阶项的单轴各向异性模型描述。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在室温下通过直流磁控溅射在 Si(111) 上生长厚度为 312 和 1011,Å{} 的 Ni 薄膜，并通过原子力显微镜、掠入射 X 射线衍射、X 射线反射率、磁力测量和角度相关铁磁共振进行研究。两种薄膜均为多晶面心立方镍，具有光滑的表面、块状（111）晶格间距和约480,emu,cm³的饱和磁化强度，并且两者均在平面内磁化。从薄膜平面到薄膜法线的共振场的角度依赖性由具有一阶和二阶项的单轴各向异性模型描述。根据该模型，对于较薄的薄膜和较厚的薄膜，分别获得了 g = 2.160±0.005 和 2.101±0.014，有效垂直各向异性分别为 (6.0±0.4)×10⁵ 和 (4.5±0.6)×10⁵,erg,cm-3。仅对面内和垂直共振进行的常规分析给出的 g 因子低 0.02--0.04。垂直线宽给出了吉尔伯特阻尼的上限 α le 0.030 和 le 0.038。
full_list.summary: 在室温下通过直流磁控溅射在 Si(111) 上生长厚度为 312 和 1011,Å{} 的 Ni 薄膜，并通过原子力显微镜、掠入射 X 射线衍射、X 射线反射率、磁力测量和角度相关铁磁共振进行研究。两种薄膜均为多晶面心立方镍，具有光滑的表面、块状（111）晶格间距和约480,emu,cm³的饱和磁化强度，并且两者均在平面内磁化。从薄膜平面到薄膜法线的共振场的角度依赖性由具有一阶和二阶项的单轴各向异性模型描述。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过角度相关铁磁共振研究 Si(111) 上溅射 Ni 薄膜的垂直各向异性和 g 因子》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Photoinduced charging and spatially selective photochemistry on ferroelectric surfaces
full_list.title_zh: 铁电表面的光致充电和空间选择性光化学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34465v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric surfaces exhibit polarization-dependent photoreactivity and provide a route to program chemical patterns through local electrical control of polarization. Observations accumulated over several decades show reaction products in domain interiors, at domain boundaries, and in other selected regions, indicating that the mechanisms extend beyond a single polarization-induced band-bending picture. Here we analyze light-induced charging and interfacial reactions on uniformly polarized ferroelectrics and domain patterns, for dry surfaces and surfaces in contact with an electrochemically active solution. A common semiconductor transport and charge-conservation framework distinguishes five cases: an isolated dry ferroelectric, a dry ferroelectric connected to a carrier reservoir, a blocking ferroelectric-electrolyte junction, a reactive interface with an external carrier return, and two opposite domains coupled through the solid and electrolyte. Analytical solutions and numerical evaluations connect stationary potentials versus illumination to differential optical spectra and finite light-step responses. We further examine the doping effects on static potentials in all five cases and dynamic photovoltage in the isolated film and a fixed-polarization, bare-surface contacted-film variant. For reactive interfaces, the same framework determines reduction and oxidation rates, their spatial distributions, and accumulated reaction amount. The analysis covers surface charging and photochemical conversion beyond deposition, while retaining the electrical and chemical boundaries that distinguish finite charging from sustained turnover, and explains the observed range of photodeposition morphologies. Finally, this framework builds the theoretical foundation for the modulated photovoltage imaging methods that can readily be realized in SPM under illumination.
full_list.abstract_zh: 铁电表面表现出与偏振相关的光反应性，并提供了通过偏振的局部电控制来编程化学图案的途径。几十年来积累的观察结果表明，在域内部、域边界和其他选定区域中都有反应产物，这表明该机制超出了单一偏振引起的能带弯曲图像。在这里，我们分析了干燥表面和与电化学活性溶液接触的表面的均匀极化铁电体和域图案上的光诱导充电和界面反应。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 铁电表面表现出与偏振相关的光反应性，并提供了通过偏振的局部电控制来编程化学图案的途径。几十年来积累的观察结果表明，在域内部、域边界和其他选定区域中都有反应产物，这表明该机制超出了单一偏振引起的能带弯曲图像。在这里，我们分析了干燥表面和与电化学活性溶液接触的表面的均匀极化铁电体和域图案上的光诱导充电和界面反应。常见的半导体传输和电荷守恒框架区分五种情况：隔离的干铁电体、连接到载流子库的干铁电体、阻塞铁电体-电解质结、具有外部载流子返回的反应界面以及通过固体和电解质耦合的两个相反域。分析解决方案和数值评估将稳态电位与照明的关系与微分光谱和有限光阶响应联系起来。我们进一步研究了所有五种情况下的掺杂对静态电位的影响以及隔离膜和固定偏振、裸表面接触膜变体中的动态光电压。对于反应界面，相同的框架决定还原和氧化速率、它们的空间分布和累积反应量。该分析涵盖了沉积之外的表面充电和光化学转化，同时保留了区分有限充电和持续周转的电气和化学边界，并解释了观察到的光沉积形态范围。最后，该框架为调制光电压成像方法奠定了理论基础，该方法可以在照明下的 SPM 中轻松实现。

full_list.title_en: Pulsed Laser Deposition of Ferroelectric SrTiO3 Shells Enables Polarization-Controlled Charge Separation in TiO2 Photoanode
full_list.title_zh: 铁电 SrTiO3 壳的脉冲激光沉积可实现 TiO2 光电阳极中偏振控制的电荷分离
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.35454v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric polarization offers a powerful route to govern the interfacial charge separation in photoelectrodes; however, chemically converted ferroelectric shells lack sub-nanometer thickness control, coherent strain retention, and chemically clean interfaces. Here, we use pulsed laser deposition to fabricate stoichiometric SrTiO3 shells on hydrothermally grown TiO2 nanorod arrays, achieving atomically defined core-shell architectures while preserving the one-dimensional transport geometry. The photocurrent density followed a volcano-shaped dependence on shell thickness and reached 1.9 mA cm-2 at 1.23 V versus RHE under AM 1.5G illumination for the optimized 15-mins sample, exceeding the established hydrothermal benchmark. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy revealed a tetragonally distorted, oxygen-stoichiometric shell, identifying coherent interfacial strain rather than defect dipoles as the origin of the ferroelectric order. Kelvin probe force microscopy directly imaged a polarization-induced built-in electric field whose magnitude scaled with charge-transfer efficiency and photocurrent density. Together, these complementary structural, chemical, electrostatic, and device-level measurements established a quantitative strain-polarization-built-in field-charge separation relationship. This work transforms ferroelectric photoanode engineering from empirical optimization into an atomically controllable and predictive materials strategy for high-efficiency solar water-splitting devices. This approach is readily extendable to visible-light absorbers and complex ferroelectric heterostructures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 铁电极化为控制光电极中的界面电荷分离提供了强有力的途径；然而，化学转化的铁电壳缺乏亚纳米厚度控制、相干应变保持和化学清洁界面。在这里，我们使用脉冲激光沉积在水热生长的 TiO2 纳米棒阵列上制造化学计量的 SrTiO3 壳，实现原子定义的核壳结构，同时保留一维输运几何形状。对于优化的 15 分钟样品，光电流密度遵循火山形状对壳厚度的依赖关系，在 AM 1.5G 照明下，1.23 V 下相对于 RHE 达到 1.9 mA cm-2，超过了既定的水热基准。

full_list.title_en: Quasiparticle Interactions in the S = 1/2 Heisenberg Antiferromagnetic Chain CuPzN
full_list.title_zh: S = 1/2 海森堡反铁磁链 CuPzN 中的准粒子相互作用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34536v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate spinon--spinon interactions in the quasi-one-dimensional S=1/2 Heisenberg antiferromagnet Cu(C₄H₄N₂)(NO₃)₂ (CuPzN) using inelastic neutron scattering. At zero field, the spectrum exhibits the canonical multi-spinon continuum of the Heisenberg chain. With increasing field we demonstrate the appearance of an energy gap 2Δ towards momentum q→ 0 between the uniform magnetization precession mode and the shifted spinon continuum. 2Δ is a direct measure of spinon backscattering interactions. Comparison with numerical matrix-product-state calculations and a recent analytical theory shows excellent agreement. By examining the integrable spin-1/2 chain, we provide an example of how quasiparticle interactions can be quantified experimentally in isotropic quantum spin systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们利用非弹性中子散射研究了准一维 S=1/2 海森堡反铁磁体 Cu(C₄H₄N2)(NO3)2 (CuPzN) 中的自旋子相互作用。在零场处，光谱呈现出海森堡链的规范多自旋连续谱。随着磁场的增加，我们证明了在均匀磁化进动模式和位移自旋连续体之间出现了朝向动量 q→ 0 的能隙 2Δ 。 2Δ 是自旋反向散射相互作用的直接测量。与数值矩阵产品状态计算和最近的分析理论的比较显示出极好的一致性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们利用非弹性中子散射研究了准一维 S=1/2 海森堡反铁磁体 Cu(C₄H₄N2)(NO3)2 (CuPzN) 中的自旋子相互作用。在零场处，光谱呈现出海森堡链的规范多自旋连续谱。随着磁场的增加，我们证明了在均匀磁化进动模式和位移自旋连续体之间出现了朝向动量 q→ 0 的能隙 2Δ 。 2Δ 是自旋反向散射相互作用的直接测量。与数值矩阵产品状态计算和最近的分析理论的比较显示出极好的一致性。通过检查可积自旋 1/2 链，我们提供了如何在各向同性量子自旋系统中通过实验量化准粒子相互作用的示例。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Theory of the 1/9 Magnetization Plateau of the Spin-1/2 Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet
full_list.title_zh: 自旋1/2戈薇海森堡反铁磁体的1/9磁化平台理论
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34439v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the 1/9 magnetization plateau of the spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet using infinite projected entangled-pair states and identify a spin-density-wave state with a 27-site unit cell and a lower variational energy than previous approaches. In contrast to higher-magnetization plateaus, which are well described by localized magnons on nonoverlapping hexagons and preserve a sixfold rotational symmetry, the 1/9 plateau only keeps a threefold rotational symmmetry and consists of a tiling by three types of 9-site clusters related by ±2π/3 rotations. These conclusions are supported by a complementary cluster mean-field theory which correctly preserves the symmetry of the higher plateaus but leads to the same spontaneous symmetry breaking for the 1/9 plateau with a qualitatively similar pattern of nine different local magnetizations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用无限投影纠缠对态研究了自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体的 1/9 磁化平台，并识别了具有 27 位晶胞和比以前的方法更低的变分能量的自旋密度波态。与高磁化平台相比，高磁化平台可以通过非重叠六边形上的局域磁振子很好地描述，并保持六重旋转对称性，而 1/9 平台仅保持三重旋转对称性，并且由三种类型的 9 点簇组成，这些簇通过 ±2π/3 旋转相关。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们使用无限投影纠缠对态研究了自旋 1/2 kagome 海森堡反铁磁体的 1/9 磁化平台，并识别了具有 27 位晶胞和比以前的方法更低的变分能量的自旋密度波态。与高磁化平台相比，高磁化平台可以通过非重叠六边形上的局域磁振子很好地描述，并保持六重旋转对称性，而 1/9 平台仅保持三重旋转对称性，并且由三种类型的 9 点簇组成，这些簇通过 ±2π/3 旋转相关。这些结论得到了互补簇平均场理论的支持，该理论正确地保留了较高高原的对称性，但导致 1/9 高原具有相同的自发对称性破缺，具有九个不同局部磁化强度的性质相似的模式。

full_list.title_en: Transition Metal-Anchored Newly Synthesized Aza-Triphenylene Monolayer for Efficient Hydrogen Evolution Reaction: Insights from DFT
full_list.title_zh: 用于高效析氢反应的过渡金属锚定新合成氮杂苯并菲单层：DFT 的见解
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34354v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles calculations were employed to explore the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) activity in two-dimensional aza-triphenylene monolayers functionalized with transition metals. Among the various metals studied, Co, Ru, and Y demonstrate outstanding catalytic efficacy, lowering the hydrogen adsorption free energy from -0.78 eV for pure aza-triphenylene to 0.05, 0.20, and 0.06 eV, respectively. Volcano plot analysis corroborates their enhanced HER activity. Ab initio molecular dynamics simulations confirm thermal stability, while the electronic structure and charge transfer analysis reveal the strong catalyst-surface interaction. Metal decoration also improves the carrier mobility, particularly for Ru-functionalized aza-triphenylene. The climbing-image nudged elastic band calculations for Co-functionalized aza-triphenylene exhibit activation barriers of 1.61, 2.29, and 5.88 eV for the Volmer, Heyrovsky, and Tafel reactions, respectively, highlighting a preferred Volmer-Heyrovsky route with the Heyrovsky being the rate-determining step. These findings highlight the potential of transition-metal-functionalized aza-triphenylene as a promising platform for developing efficient HER electrocatalysts.
full_list.abstract_zh: 采用第一原理计算来探索过渡金属功能化的二维氮杂苯并菲单层中的析氢反应（HER）活性。在所研究的各种金属中，Co、Ru 和 Y 表现出出色的催化功效，分别将纯氮杂苯并菲的氢吸附自由能从 -0.78 eV 降低到 0.05、0.20 和 0.06 eV。火山图分析证实了它们增强的 HER 活性。从头算分子动力学模拟证实了热稳定性，而电子结构和电荷转移分析揭示了强烈的催化剂-表面相互作用。金属装饰还可以提高载流子迁移率，特别是对于钌官能化的氮杂苯并菲。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 采用第一原理计算来探索过渡金属功能化的二维氮杂苯并菲单层中的析氢反应（HER）活性。在所研究的各种金属中，Co、Ru 和 Y 表现出出色的催化功效，分别将纯氮杂苯并菲的氢吸附自由能从 -0.78 eV 降低到 0.05、0.20 和 0.06 eV。火山图分析证实了它们增强的 HER 活性。从头算分子动力学模拟证实了热稳定性，而电子结构和电荷转移分析揭示了强烈的催化剂-表面相互作用。金属装饰还可以提高载流子迁移率，特别是对于钌官能化的氮杂苯并菲。共官能化氮杂苯并菲的爬升图像微移弹性带计算显示，Volmer、Heyrovsky 和 Tafel 反应的活化势垒分别为 1.61、2.29 和 5.88 eV，突出显示了首选的 Volmer-Heyrovsky 路线，其中 Heyrovsky 是速率决定步骤。这些发现凸显了过渡金属功能化氮杂苯并菲作为开发高效 HER 电催化剂的有前途的平台的潜力。

full_list.title_en: Tuning from intrinsic to disorder-dominated quantum states in a kagome antiferromagnet
full_list.title_zh: Kagome 反铁磁体中从本征量子态调整为无序主导量子态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34230v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The spin-1/2 kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet (AFM) provides a paradigmatic platform for realizing quantum spin-liquid (QSL) and magnetization-plateau states. Experimental progress, however, has been hindered by structural disorder, whose effects on these quantum states remain elusive. A key experimental challenge is therefore to connect intrinsic and disorder-dominated regimes through controlled disorder and identify emergent degrees of freedom associated with disorder. Here we introduce controlled point defects through electron irradiation into the spin-1/2 kagome AFM YCu3(OH)6.5Br2.5 (YCOB) and track the resulting evolution of its low-energy magnetic states. High-field magnetic torque measurements reveal that the 1/9 and 1/3 magnetization plateaus are strongly suppressed by only ~0.05% irradiation-induced defects, demonstrating that these delicate quantum many-body states are extraordinarily fragile against dilute disorder. Moreover, the irradiation induces a sign reversal of the magnetic torque only at low temperatures and low fields, indicating the emergence of correlated defect-induced moments rather than isolated free spins. Remarkably, the characteristic scaling of the magnetic specific heat, absent in pristine YCOB, progressively emerges with increasing disorder. These findings establish dilute disorder as an effective tuning parameter that drives the kagome AFM from intrinsic quantum states toward a disorder-dominated regime. The contrasting responses further identify pristine YCOB as an exceptionally clean kagome AFM for accessing intrinsic quantum states.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Kagome 反铁磁体中从本征量子态调整为无序主导量子态》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Winding-Controlled Topological Descendants of Antialtermagnets
full_list.title_zh: 反终磁体绕组控制拓扑后代
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.33252v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Odd-parity spin splitting constrains magnetic band crossings but does not determine their topological descendants. We show that the Chern contribution of an isolated inverted sector is controlled by the phase winding of its transverse mass pair: when the masses and tangential velocities reverse together, contributions from successive Dirac points add rather than cancel. This distinguishes topological winding from the polynomial degree labeling the magnetic parent. For specified complementary masses, periodic tetragonal h- and hexagonal j-wave models host eight and twelve same-chirality Weyl points on a momentum plane, with gapped-slice Chern numbers |C|=4 and 6, respectively. A microscopic four-band p-wave model identifies an antiunitary obstruction to first-order transverse masses and demonstrates a symmetry-broken C=1 phase at quarter filling. First-principles calculations for the proposed coplanar spin-vortex texture of LaMnAu₅ reveal the h-wave nodal pattern, its anisotropic spin--orbit reconstruction, and a mirror-channel spectral response that reverses under opposite spin rotations. Together, these results distinguish the symmetry of an odd-parity magnetic parent from the mass structure controlling the topology of its descendants.

full_list.title_en: Evaluating the Structural Basis for Polar Altermagnet Candidate Ca₃(Ru,Ti)₂O₇
full_list.title_zh: 评估极性交变磁体候选物 Ca₃(Ru,Ti)2O₇ 的结构基础
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.16181v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay between polar and altermagnetic orders remains largely unexplored in the broader landscape of correlated electron systems. Density functional theory (DFT) within the PBEsol + U treatment propose Ca₃Ru₂O₇ as a polar altermagnet, reliant on the transformation of the experimentally reported Bb2₁m phase to a lower symmetry Pn2₁a structure. Here, we perform a targeted search for the Pn2₁a phase using synchrotron X-ray diffraction on single crystals of Ca₃Ru₂O₇ and Ca₃(Ru₀.₉₉Ti₀.₀₁)₂O₇. No diffraction signature of the Pn2₁a structure is detected down to 20 K within experimental limits. Through diffraction simulations, we translate this result into a quantitative upper bound on the symmetry breaking distortion amplitude, which we find to be significantly smaller than the DFT predicted distortion. Our DFT calculations further motivate dilute Ti substitution (lesssim 2%) as an alternative route to stabilize the low symmetry phase, for which we again find no clear evidence for this putative Pn2₁a structure that hosts altermagnetism. Our findings indicate that PBEsol + U over-stabilizes a Pn2₁a distortion, and the measured bounds provide benchmark for future calculations. Ti substitution exceeding sim3% reveals a chemically tunable polar altermagnetic phase within the Bb2₁m structure and we theoretically demonstrate that the spin-splitting can be tuned by Ti substitution. By combining DFT, diffraction simulations and synchrotron X-ray measurements, our study demonstrates a general methodology to quantify subtle structural distortions that underlie emergent electronic and magnetic phases.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在更广泛的相关电子系统领域中，极序和交变磁序之间的相互作用在很大程度上仍未得到探索。 PBEsol + U 处理中的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 提出 Ca3Ru2O7 作为极性交替磁体，依赖于实验报道的 Bb2₁m 相向较低对称性 Pn2₁a 结构的转变。在这里，我们利用同步加速器X射线衍射对Ca 3 Ru 2 O 7 和Ca 3 (Ru 0.9 9 Ti 0. 0 1) 2 O 7的单晶进行有针对性的搜索Pn2₁a相。

full_list.title_zh: 二维石墨烯超晶格中固有的 i 波交变磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2604.19661v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets feature unconventional magnetism due to their momentum-dependent spin splitting purely driven by magnetic order, for which a variety of transition-metal-based d-wave altermagnets have been proposed. However, carbon-based altermagnets in graphene structures remain elusive, even though magnetism in graphene nanostructures has been widely demonstrated. Here, we establish a symmetry-guided design principle to engineer i-wave altermagnets in graphene antidot superlattices and demonstrate the emergence of altermagnetic states in specific monolayer and bilayer graphene superlattices. By combining first principles methods and atomistic tight binding models, we show the appearance of an interaction-induced i-wave altermagnetic splitting, stemming from the intrinsic magnetic instability of 2D graphene antidot superlattices. Our work establishes a strategy to engineer i-wave altermagnetism in a graphene platform, putting forward a carbon-based platform for altermagnetic spintronics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 交变磁体具有非常规磁性，因为其动量相关的自旋分裂纯粹由磁序驱动，为此，人们提出了各种基于过渡金属的 d 波交变磁体。然而，尽管石墨烯纳米结构中的磁性已被广泛证明，但石墨烯结构中的碳基交流磁体仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们建立了一种对称引导的设计原理，在石墨烯反点超晶格中设计 i 波交变磁体，并证明了特定单层和双层石墨烯超晶格中交变磁态的出现。通过结合第一性原理方法和原子紧束缚模型，我们展示了相互作用引起的 i 波交变磁分裂的出现，这种分裂源于二维石墨烯反点超晶格的固有磁不稳定性。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《二维石墨烯超晶格中固有的 i 波交变磁性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Ultra-broadband Mid to Long-wave Infrared Spintronic Poisson Bolometer
full_list.title_zh: 超宽带中长波红外自旋电子泊松测辐射热计
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.11733v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Infrared detectors have traditionally been divided into two fundamental classes, mid-wave (MWIR, 3-5 um) and long-wave (LWIR, 8-14 um). Integrating MWIR and LWIR within a single device is challenging due to distinct materials, cooling needs, and detection mechanisms, while such integration is critical for improved object recognition, temperature estimation, and environmental sensing. In this work, we demonstrate a Spintronic Poisson (SP) bolometer enabling room-temperature ultra-broadband sensing across 3-14 um. Unlike conventional bolometers that rely on continuous analog signals, the SP bolometer implements a Poisson-counting detection paradigm, encoding temperature in discrete stochastic events, which turns thermal noise from a limitation into the basis of the estimator itself. We fabricate the SP bolometer using a spintronic transduction layer integrated with a plasmonic nanoantenna array to enhance broadband infrared absorption. Using spintronic transduction, the device achieves the noise-equivalent temperature difference (NETD, thermal sensitivity metric) of 80-100 mK at 300 K, surpassing uncooled detectors and approaching cooled technologies. This work establishes a statistical detection paradigm for room-temperature infrared sensing with broad application potential.
full_list.abstract_zh: 红外探测器传统上分为两个基本类别：中波（MWIR，3-5 um）和长波（LWIR，8-14 um）。由于不同的材料、冷却需求和检测机制，将中波红外和长波红外集成到单个设备中具有挑战性，而这种集成对于改进物体识别、温度估计和环境传感至关重要。在这项工作中，我们演示了一种自旋电子泊松 (SP) 测辐射热计，可在 3-14 um 范围内实现室温超宽带传感。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 红外探测器传统上分为两个基本类别：中波（MWIR，3-5 um）和长波（LWIR，8-14 um）。由于不同的材料、冷却需求和检测机制，将中波红外和长波红外集成到单个设备中具有挑战性，而这种集成对于改进物体识别、温度估计和环境传感至关重要。在这项工作中，我们演示了一种自旋电子泊松 (SP) 测辐射热计，可在 3-14 um 范围内实现室温超宽带传感。与依赖连续模拟信号的传统测辐射热计不同，SP 测辐射热计实现了泊松计数检测范例，以离散随机事件对温度进行编码，从而将热噪声从限制转变为估计器本身的基础。我们使用与等离子体纳米天线阵列集成的自旋电子传导层来制造 SP 辐射热测量计，以增强宽带红外吸收。利用自旋电子传导，该器件在 300 K 下实现了 80-100 mK 的噪声等效温差（NETD，热灵敏度指标），超越了非冷却探测器并接近冷却技术。这项工作建立了具有广泛应用潜力的室温红外传感统计检测范例。

full_list.title_en: Observation of gapped Dirac magnons in a Co bilayer grown on Ru(0001)
full_list.title_zh: 在Ru (0001)上生长的Co双层中间隙狄拉克磁控子的观察
full_list.abstract: Author(s): Khalil Zakeri, Arthur Ernst, and Christopher Hins Long celebrated in graphene, Dirac physics inspires the search for similar phenomena in magnonic systems. Here, the authors experimentally demonstrate that magnons in an epitaxial Co bilayer on Ru(0001) exhibit Dirac properties near the Brillouin zone corner. Remarkably, the substrate does not destroy the essential physics; despite breaking sublattice symmetry and opening a gap, local valley topology remains intact. Beyond opening possibilities for discovering Dirac magnons in other ultrathin 3 d magnetic films, these findings hold promise for on-chip magnonic applications. [Phys. Rev. B 114, L200405] Published Tue Oct 27, 2026
full_list.abstract_zh: 作者： Khalil Zakeri ， Arthur Ernst和Christopher Hins Long在石墨烯中庆祝，狄拉克物理学激发了在强子系统中寻找类似现象的灵感。在这里，作者通过实验表明， Ru （ 0001 ）上的外延Co双层中的磁子在布里渊区角附近表现出狄拉克性质。值得注意的是，基板不会破坏基本的物理特性；尽管打破了亚晶格对称性并开辟了缝隙，但局部谷拓扑仍然完好无损。除了在其他超薄3d磁性薄膜中发现狄拉克磁子之外，这些发现还为片上磁子应用带来了希望。

full_list.title_en: Andreev Reflection at a Graphene Normal-Superconductor Interface: A Lattice-Continuum Comparison
full_list.title_zh: 石墨烯法向超导体界面处的安德烈耶夫反射：晶格连续体比较
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34270v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compare quadratic continuum and nearest-neighbour tight-binding models of Andreev reflection at a clean graphene normal-superconductor interface. For abrupt changes in chemical potential and pairing potential, with unchanged hopping, the lattice model yields four independent boundary conditions. Its reflection probabilities agree with independent Kwant calculations to numerical precision for the channels examined. We investigate trigonal warping and its effect on the relation between momentum and group velocity. For (μ_N,μ_S,Δ₀,E)/t₀=(0.5,1,0.1,0.05), the Andreev-reflection probability for the ξ=+1 valley peaks at 19.9^circ in the lattice model, versus 3.4^circ in the quadratic continuum model. These parameters lie outside the expected validity regime of the low-energy approximation. As all energy scales are reduced at fixed ratios, the central angular response and conductance become more consistent with lattice results. The quadratic continuum boundary problem also requires short-wavelength auxiliary modes outside the validity range of the valley expansion. Thus, differences cannot be attributed to bulk dispersion alone. A small excitation energy relative to chemical potential does not ensure continuum validity; relevant energy scales, modes in both regions, and interface matching assumptions must also be considered.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们比较了干净石墨烯法向超导体界面上安德烈夫反射的二次连续谱和最近邻紧束缚模型。对于化学势和配对势的突然变化，在跳跃不变的情况下，晶格模型产生四个独立的边界条件。其反射概率与所检查通道的数值精度的独立 Kwant 计算一致。我们研究三角扭曲及其对动量和群速度之间关系的影响。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们比较了干净石墨烯法向超导体界面上安德烈夫反射的二次连续谱和最近邻紧束缚模型。对于化学势和配对势的突然变化，在跳跃不变的情况下，晶格模型产生四个独立的边界条件。其反射概率与所检查通道的数值精度的独立 Kwant 计算一致。我们研究三角扭曲及其对动量和群速度之间关系的影响。对于 (μ_N,μ_S,Δ₀,E)/t₀=(0.5,1,0.1,0.05)， xi=+1 谷的 Andreev 反射概率在晶格模型中的 19.9^circ 处达到峰值，而在二次连续介质模型中为 3.4^circ。这些参数位于低能量近似的预期有效性范围之外。由于所有能量尺度以固定比率减小，中心角响应和电导变得与晶格结果更加一致。二次连续边界问题还需要谷扩展有效范围之外的短波长辅助模式。因此，差异不能仅归因于体积分散。相对于化学势而言较小的激发能并不能确保连续体有效性；还必须考虑相关的能量尺度、两个区域的模式以及界面匹配假设。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Anisotropic magneto-elastic coupling in the quasi-2D Ising magnet Li₂FeSiO₄ and thermodynamic signature of low-energy orbital excitations
full_list.title_zh: 准二维伊辛磁体 Li2FeSiO4 中的各向异性磁弹性耦合和低能轨道激发的热力学特征
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.35341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The relevance of spin, lattice and orbital degrees of freedom in the quasi-2D Ising-like magnet Li₂FeSiO₄ is demonstrated by thermal expansion and specific heat measurements supported by numerical studies. By means of thermodynamic and Grüneisen analysis, we separate the orbital signatures and quantify the energy gap and its pressure dependence from the experimental data as Δsim 300 - 350 K and partial ln Δ/partial pᵣₘ c approx -4.6 %/GPa). Both values excellently agree with the theoretical DFT predictions. The thermal expansion anomalies associated with the onset of long-range magnetic order imply significant magneto-elastic coupling and are used to determine the anisotropic uniaxial strain dependencies of Tᵣₘ N. They are dominated by the in-plane (i.e., c axis) response (partial ln Tᵣₘ N )/partial pᵣₘ c simeq 15 %/GPa while the (negative) a axis and (positive) out-of-plane (b axis) pressure dependencies are much smaller. Short-range magnetic order extends well above Tᵣₘ N but is not driven by the same energy scale as Tᵣₘ N as evidenced by the observation of non-monotonic in-plane distortion, sign-change of the Grüneisen parameter, and failure of Grüneisen scaling.
full_list.abstract_zh: 数值研究支持的热膨胀和比热测量证明了准二维类伊辛磁体 Li2FeSiO4 中自旋、晶格和轨道自由度的相关性。通过热力学和 Grüneisen 分析，我们分离了轨道特征，并根据实验数据量化了能隙及其压力依赖性，如 Δsim 300 - 350 K 和部分 ln Δ/部分 pᵣₘ c 约 -4.6 %/GPa)。这两个值都与理论 DFT 预测非常一致。与长程磁序开始相关的热膨胀异常意味着显着的磁弹性耦合，并用于确定 Tᵣₘ N 的各向异性单轴应变依赖性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 数值研究支持的热膨胀和比热测量证明了准二维类伊辛磁体 Li2FeSiO4 中自旋、晶格和轨道自由度的相关性。通过热力学和 Grüneisen 分析，我们分离了轨道特征，并根据实验数据量化了能隙及其压力依赖性，如 Δsim 300 - 350 K 和部分 ln Δ/部分 pᵣₘ c 约 -4.6 %/GPa)。这两个值都与理论 DFT 预测非常一致。与长程磁序开始相关的热膨胀异常意味着显着的磁弹性耦合，并用于确定 Tᵣₘ N 的各向异性单轴应变依赖性。它们由面内（即 c 轴）响应主导（部分 ln Tᵣₘ N ）/部分 pᵣₘ c simeq 15 %/GPa，而（负）a 轴和（正）平面外（b 轴）压力依赖性要小得多。短程磁序延伸远高于 Tᵣₘ N，但不是由与 Tᵣₘ N 相同的能量尺度驱动，这一点通过观察非单调面内畸变、Grüneisen 参数的符号变化以及 Grüneisen 标度的失败所证明。
full_list.summary: 数值研究支持的热膨胀和比热测量证明了准二维类伊辛磁体 Li2FeSiO4 中自旋、晶格和轨道自由度的相关性。通过热力学和 Grüneisen 分析，我们分离了轨道特征，并根据实验数据量化了能隙及其压力依赖性，如 Δsim 300 - 350 K 和部分 ln Δ/部分 pᵣₘ c 约 -4.6 %/GPa)。这两个值都与理论 DFT 预测非常一致。与长程磁序开始相关的热膨胀异常意味着显着的磁弹性耦合，并用于确定 Tᵣₘ N 的各向异性单轴应变依赖性。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Anyonic membranes and Pontryagin statistics
full_list.title_zh: 任意离子膜和庞特里亚金统计
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2509.14314v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Anyons, unique to two spatial dimensions, underlie extraordinary phenomena such as the fractional quantum Hall effect, but their generalization to higher dimensions has remained elusive. The topology of Eilenberg-MacLane spaces constrains the loop statistics to be only bosonic or fermionic in any dimension. In this work, we introduce the novel anyonic statistics for membrane excitations in four dimensions. Analogous to the Z_N-particle exhibiting ZN× gcd₍₂,N₎ anyonic statistics in two dimensions, we show that the Z_N-membrane possesses ZN× gcd₍₃,N₎ anyonic statistics in four dimensions. Given unitary volume operators that create membrane excitations on the boundary, we propose an explicit 56-step unitary sequence that detects the membrane statistics. We further analyze the boundary theory of (5+1)D 1-form Z_N symmetry-protected topological phases and demonstrate that their domain walls realize all possible anyonic membrane statistics. We then show that the Z₃ subgroup persists in all higher dimensions. In addition to the standard fermionic Z₂ membrane statistics arising from Stiefel-Whitney classes, membranes also exhibit Z₃ statistics associated with Pontryagin classes. We explicitly verify that the 56-step process detects the nontrivial Z₃ statistics in 5, 6, and 7 spatial dimensions. Moreover, in 7 and higher dimensions, the statistics of membrane excitations stabilize to Z₂ × Z₃, with the Z₃ sector consistently captured by this process.
full_list.abstract_zh: 任意子是二维空间维度所特有的，是分数量子霍尔效应等非凡现象的基础，但它们向更高维度的推广仍然难以捉摸。 Eilenberg-MacLane 空间的拓扑将环统计限制为在任何维度上仅是玻色子或费米子。在这项工作中，我们介绍了四个维度的膜激发的新颖的任意子统计。类似于 Z_N 粒子在二维中表现出 ZN× gcd₍2,N₎ 任意统计量，我们证明 Z_N 膜在四维中具有 ZN× gcd₍₃,N₎ 任意统计量。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 任意子是二维空间维度所特有的，是分数量子霍尔效应等非凡现象的基础，但它们向更高维度的推广仍然难以捉摸。 Eilenberg-MacLane 空间的拓扑将环统计限制为在任何维度上仅是玻色子或费米子。在这项工作中，我们介绍了四个维度的膜激发的新颖的任意子统计。类似于 Z_N 粒子在二维中表现出 ZN× gcd₍2,N₎ 任意统计量，我们证明 Z_N 膜在四维中具有 ZN× gcd₍₃,N₎ 任意统计量。给定在边界上产生膜激励的酉体积算子，我们提出了一个显式的 56 步酉序列来检测膜统计数据。我们进一步分析了 (5+1)D 1-型 Z_N 对称保护拓扑相的边界理论，并证明它们的畴壁实现了所有可能的任意子膜统计。然后我们证明 Z₃ 子群在所有更高维度中都存在。除了来自 Stiefel-Whitney 类的标准费米子 Z2 膜统计之外，膜还表现出与 Pontryagin 类相关的 Z₃ 统计。我们明确验证了 56 步过程检测到了 5、6 和 7 个空间维度的非平凡 Z₃ 统计数据。此外，在 7 维及更高维度中，膜激发的统计数据稳定在 Z2 × Z₃，Z₃ 扇区始终被该过程捕获。

full_list.title_en: Axion Quasibound States in the Continuum and Their Enhanced Axion Nonlinearity
full_list.title_zh: 连续体中的轴子准束缚态及其增强的轴子非线性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.34195v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dynamical axion quasiparticles (DAQs) in condensed-matter systmes have emerged as a fascinating platform for exploring axion physics and nonlinear optical phenomena. However, the amplitude of the coherent oscillating θ field is even smaller than that of the static counterpart, making the experimental observation of DAQs particularly challenging. Here, we introduce symmetry-sensitive bound states in the continuum (BICs) physics to enable the all-optical detection of DAQs and enhance DAQ-mediated second-harmonic generation (SHG). Specifically, we uncover that DAQs induce optical shear that breaks the C₂z symmetry of metagratings without geometric engineering, thereby converting symmetry-protected BICs into axion quasi-BICs (qBICs). In this context, the evolution of the quality factor and topological charge in momentum space, together with the appearance of optical resonances in far field associated with axion qBICs, offers achiral optical signatures for DAQ detection beyond the widely used Kerr and Faraday effects. Furthermore, by exploiting axion qBICs in the critical coupling regime to enhance fundamental optical field, we show that the SHG efficiency can be enhanced more than 10⁵-fold compared to bulk axion materials, achieving a conversion efficiency exceeding 10⁻⁶~W⁻¹. The SHG is governed by the magnetoelectric coupling, which differs from that in conventional SHG materials. Our findings establish a new approach for probing DAQs via achiral optical effects, while providing a versatile route for reconfigurable photonics and terahertz nonlinear optics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 凝聚态系统中的动态轴子准粒子（DAQ）已成为探索轴子物理和非线性光学现象的迷人平台。然而，相干振荡 θ 场的振幅甚至比静态对应物的振幅还要小，这使得 DAQ 的实验观察特别具有挑战性。在这里，我们在连续介质 (BIC) 物理中引入对称敏感束缚态，以实现 DAQ 的全光学检测并增强 DAQ 介导的二次谐波生成 (SHG)。具体来说，我们发现 DAQ 会产生光学剪切，无需几何工程即可打破元光栅的 C2z 对称性，从而将对称保护的 BIC 转换为轴子准 BIC（qBIC）。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 凝聚态系统中的动态轴子准粒子（DAQ）已成为探索轴子物理和非线性光学现象的迷人平台。然而，相干振荡 θ 场的振幅甚至比静态对应物的振幅还要小，这使得 DAQ 的实验观察特别具有挑战性。在这里，我们在连续介质 (BIC) 物理中引入对称敏感束缚态，以实现 DAQ 的全光学检测并增强 DAQ 介导的二次谐波生成 (SHG)。具体来说，我们发现 DAQ 会产生光学剪切，无需几何工程即可打破元光栅的 C2z 对称性，从而将对称保护的 BIC 转换为轴子准 BIC（qBIC）。在这种情况下，动量空间中品质因数和拓扑电荷的演变，以及与轴子 qBIC 相关的远场光学共振的出现，为 DAQ 检测提供了超越广泛使用的克尔和法拉第效应的非手性光学特征。此外，通过在临界耦合状态下利用轴子qBIC来增强基本光场，我们发现与块状轴子材料相比，SHG效率可以提高10⁵倍以上，实现超过10⁻⁶~W⁻1的转换效率。二次谐波由磁电耦合控制，这与传统二次谐波材料不同。我们的研究结果建立了一种通过非手性光学效应探测 DAQ 的新方法，同时为可重构光子学和太赫兹非线性光学提供了通用途径。
